title: DocMind AI
summary: Full-stack AI-powered document intelligence platform using RAG, vector embeddings, similarity search, and contextual LLM responses.
highlights: Document chunking and vector embeddings with PostgreSQL / pgvector
JWT authentication, document management, chat sessions, and responsive interfaces
Provider-agnostic AI architecture supporting OpenAI and Ollama

title: E-Commerce
summary: Full-stack e-commerce platform with secure authentication, role-based authorization, product and order management, and business analytics.
highlights: Product, order, inventory, and user management modules
JWT authentication and role-based access control
Reusable backend architecture and optimized database operations
Responsive UI with component-driven frontend architecture
